attributes.description: Site reliability view of the Cisco Secure Email Gateway: gateway health KPIs, mail flow and delivery rates, resource utilization trends, and per-host fleet status. Source: metrics-cisco_secure_email_gateway* (datasets: system_status, metrics, delivery_status).

embeddableConfig.content:

query.esql:
FROM metrics-cisco_secure_email_gateway*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart
  AND @timestamp < ?_tend
  AND cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.destination_domain IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Delivered Recipients` = TOP(@timestamp, 1, "desc", cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.delivered_recipients), `Hard Bounces` = TOP(@timestamp, 1, "desc", cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.hard_bounces), `Soft Bounces` = TOP(@timestamp, 1, "desc", cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.soft_bounces), `Latest Host Status` = TOP(@timestamp, 1, "desc", cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.latest_host_status) BY `Destination Domain` = cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.destination_domain
| EVAL `Delivered Recipients` = MV_FIRST(`Delivered Recipients`), `Hard Bounces` = MV_FIRST(`Hard Bounces`), `Soft Bounces` = MV_FIRST(`Soft Bounces`), `Latest Host Status` = MV_FIRST(`Latest Host Status`)
| KEEP `Destination Domain`, `Delivered Recipients`, `Hard Bounces`, `Soft Bounces`, `Latest Host Status`
| SORT `Delivered Recipients` DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 20

FROM metrics-cisco_secure_email_gateway*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart
  AND @timestamp < ?_tend
  AND cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.destination_domain IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Delivered Recipients` = TOP(@timestamp, 1, "desc", cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.delivered_recipients), `Hard Bounces` = TOP(@timestamp, 1, "desc", cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.hard_bounces), `Soft Bounces` = TOP(@timestamp, 1, "desc", cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.soft_bounces), `Latest Host Status` = TOP(@timestamp, 1, "desc", cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.latest_host_status) BY `Destination Domain` = cisco_secure_email_gateway.delivery_status.destination_domain
| EVAL `Delivered Recipients` = MV_FIRST(`Delivered Recipients`), `Hard Bounces` = MV_FIRST(`Hard Bounces`), `Soft Bounces` = MV_FIRST(`Soft Bounces`), `Latest Host Status` = MV_FIRST(`Latest Host Status`)
| KEEP `Destination Domain`, `Delivered Recipients`, `Hard Bounces`, `Soft Bounces`, `Latest Host Status`
| SORT `Delivered Recipients` DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 20

FROM metrics-cisco_secure_email_gateway*
